description: Application-owned, offline-only Illinois SOS five-file ingestion. An operator explicitly places one complete official daily package under data/imports; the worker performs no discovery or network access and writes only operation-scoped releases and receipts.
redirect_policy: No HTTP requests, redirects, discovery, or automated acquisition are permitted.
retry: No automatic retry. Inspect the durable operation receipt and replace or correct the explicitly selected package.
checkpoint: One UUID operation owns its start record, operation-scoped release root, independently verified source manifest, and terminal receipt.
idempotency: The existing source connector binds the common source RUN DATE and ordered SHA-256 values of all five selected files. Re-running creates a distinct operation and never changes a national or source current pointer.
cancellation: Cancellation is cooperative. The operation records CANCELLED and removes only its unpublished operation-scoped release directory; selected inputs are never modified.
retention_profile: Operator inputs remain under data/imports. Operation-scoped privacy-minimized evidence and receipts remain local-review-only until an explicit retention action.
